capabilities: segment note text into typed nodes with confidence scores and offsets
extract LLM relationships like supports, contradicts, and causes
derive precedes edges from document order
write a .ir.json.md intermediate representation beside the note
verify the compiled graph against the source text
extras: Not yet in the Community Plugins store; requires manual copy of main.js and manifest.json into the plugins folder. Warns that vault-sync tools will carry the stored API key, and that large structured technical documents are not yet well supported.
problem: Obsidian notes are plain text, so there is no structured representation of claims, observations, decisions, and their relationships that can be traced back to source text.
summary: Semantic IR compiler that segments a note into typed nodes, extracts relationships with verbatim evidence spans, and writes a .ir.json.md graph file.
